I see no reason to limit sticky count. While having lots of stickies (obviously) reduces the amount of rotating user generated content visible to the user without scrolling, they can also be of critical importance to managing a sub. For instance, I recently mentioned the idea of /v/gaming doing a recurring raffle to raise money for voat. Such a contest would greatly benefit from being stickied, but, if it were stickied, would remove the ability of /v/gaming to have any kind of announcement sticky. Why not allow 3 stickies per sub (I can't see a situation in which more than 3 would be needed), or better yet, unlimited (though if we start having to hit next page before seeing new content, that's a problem, hence the proposed limit of 3).
